sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

3. The Petitioners have filed this writ petition with the following prayer:-
"xxx xxx xxx xxx 1. The award passed and the consequential notice issued by O.P.No.2 shall not be quashed after declaring the same as illegal.
2. The O.P.No.2 shall not be directed to recalculate the compensation on the basis of Rule 26 of the RFCTLA RR Act, 2013 3.

The Land Acquistion Collector, Sundargarh (O.P. No.2) shall not be directed to refer the dispute raised under Annexure-2 & 3 to the Ld. Court of Land Acquisition and Land Rehabilitation Authority U/s.64(1) of the RFCTLA RR Act, 2013."
4. He further submits that though highlighting their grievances, the Petitioners have filed representation vide Annexures-2 & 3 to the writ petition, but till date nothing has been done in the matter.
In such background, he prays that a direction be issued to Opposite Party No.2 to take a decision on the above noted petitions within a specific time period.
